scripts.prepare:pages: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist-pages',{recursive:true}); for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dist')){ if(f.endsWith('.html')||f.endsWith('.js')||f.endsWith('.ico')||f.endsWith('.css')||f==='_headers'){ fs.copyFileSync('dist/'+f,'dist-pages/'+f); } } if(fs.existsSync('public/_headers')) fs.copyFileSync('public/_headers','dist-pages/_headers'); else if(fs.existsSync('_headers')) fs.copyFileSync('_headers','dist-pages/_headers');"
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run prepare:pages && npx wrangler pages deploy dist-pages --project-name=cisco-automated --branch develop
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run prepare:pages && npx wrangler pages deploy dist-pages --project-name=cisco-automated --branch main
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run prepare:pages && npx wrangler pages deploy dist-pages --project-name=cisco-automated
